newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed, Pliva most active.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed, Pliva most active.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed amid buoyant activity on Tuesday, as drugs firm Pliva played a starring role with some 25,000 shares sold.
* Of 18 active issues four rose, eight fell and six were flat.
* Volume was ten times higher at 37,037 shares, turnover rose to 18.8 million kuna from Friday's meagre 1.5 million.
* Pliva was the most traded issue, selling 25,005 shares. It rose 28 kuna to 512.
* Top gainer cementworks Nasicecement added 55 kuna or 14.1 percent to 445 kuna on volume of 3,820 shares.
* Biggest decliner shipper Atlantska Plovidba lost 10 kuna or 5.9 percent to 160, selling 186 shares.
